questions.question: In a college, class A has 25 students and class B has 30 students. If the number of students in class A increases by 20% in the first year and by 10% in the second year, and the number of students in class B increases by a total of 20% in two years, what is the overall percentage increase in the total number of students in the college over the two years? (Give your answer rounded off to 2 decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective percentage increase in **Class A** = 20 + 10 + (20 × 10) ÷ 100 = 32%.

Percentage increase in **Class B** = 20%.

Total Increase = (Initial A × 32% + Initial B × 20%) ÷ Total Initial

Total Increase = (25 × 32 + 30 × 20) ÷ 55 = (800 + 600) ÷ 55 = 1400 ÷ 55 ≈ 25.45%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25.45%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Initial students in **Class A** = 25, **Class B** = 30.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9415d119a52dc64ac8a34d448775cab1e3c6176717dcaf3535d85ac02d52b41f.png] 

⇒ **Total Initial Students** = 25 + 30 = 55

⇒ Students in **Class A** after 1st year = 25 + (20% of 25) = 25 + 5 = 30

⇒ Students in **Class A** after 2ⁿd year = 30 + (10% of 30) = 30 + 3 = 33

⇒ Students in **Class B** after 2 years = 30 + (20% of 30) = 30 + 6 = 36

⇒ **Total Final Students** = 33 + 36 = 69

⇒ **Overall Increase** = 69 − 55 = 14

⇒ **Overall % Increase** = (14 ÷ 55) × 100 = 25.4545...

**∴ The correct answer is 25.45%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Increase

If a value increases by x% and then by y%, the net increase is given by [x + y + (xy ÷ 100)]%.

Weighted Average Percentage

The overall percentage change of a combined group is the sum of (individual change × its weight) divided by the total weight.

Base Value in Percentage

Always identify the original total as the base for calculating the overall percentage increase: (Change ÷ Initial Total) × 100.

questions.question: A dealer buys two articles X and Y for ₹700 each. He marks each of them at the same price. He sells X by giving two successive discounts of 60% and 20% and still earns ₹630 as profit. If he sells Y at a single discount of 76%, then what is the profit percentage on Y?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**SP of X** = 700 + 630 = 1330

Successive discounts of 60% and 20% ⇒ Net multiplier = 0.40 × 0.80 = 0.32

⇒ 32% of **MP** = 1330

For **Article Y**, a 76% discount ⇒ **SP** = (100 − 76)% = 24% of **MP**

**SP of Y** = (1330 ÷ 32) × 24 = 1330 × (3/4) = 997.5

**Profit percentage on Y** = [(997.5 − 700) ÷ 700] × 100 = 42.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 42.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (**CP**) of **X** and **Y** = ₹700 each

Profit on **X** = ₹630

Successive discounts on **X** = 60% and 20%

Single discount on **Y** = 76%

**Formula Used:**

**Selling Price (SP)** = **Cost Price (CP)** + **Profit**

**Net Discount** for successive d₁ and d₂ = [d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂ ÷ 100)]%

**SP** = **Marked Price (MP)** × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/712cfcffb0158cfb01756b63a2d31c937218ed30cd66f16a7caacfdecc873f86.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **SP of X** = 700 + 630 = 1330

⇒ Effective discount on **X** = 60 + 20 − (60 × 20 ÷ 100) = 80 − 12 = 68%

⇒ **SP of X** = **MP** × (100 − 68) ÷ 100 = 0.32 × **MP**

⇒ 0.32 × **MP** = 1330 ⇒ **MP** = 1330 ÷ 0.32 = 4156.25

⇒ **SP of Y** = 4156.25 × (100 − 76) ÷ 100 = 4156.25 × 0.24 = 997.5

⇒ **Profit on Y** = 997.5 − 700 = 297.5

⇒ **Profit % on Y** = (297.5 ÷ 700) × 100 = 42.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 42.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Shortcut

Instead of calculating net %, use multiplying factors: Total multiplier = (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × ... × (1 − dₙ/100).

CP-MP-Profit-Discount Relation

The ratio of Marked Price to Cost Price is given by: MP/CP = (100 + Profit%) / (100 − Discount%).

Markup Percentage

The percentage by which the cost price is increased to set the marked price: Markup % = [(MP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.

questions.question: What sum of money (in ₹) will yield ₹720 as simple interest in 3 years at 6% per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage for **3 years** at **6%** per annum = 3 × 6% = **18%**.

Given that 18% of the **Principal** = ₹720.

**Principal** (100%) = (720 ÷ 18) × 100.

**Principal** = 40 × 100 = ₹4000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Simple Interest** (SI) = ₹720

**Time** (T) = 3 years

**Rate** (R) = 6% per annum

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c791b4093cd6bbade0be81f52dd0b9788ba15857b8a0b797c8d6009fc50ea61.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Where P = **Principal**, R = **Rate of interest**, T = **Time period**

**Calculations:**

⇒ 720 = (P × 6 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 720 = (P × 18) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (720 × 100) ÷ 18

⇒ P = 40 × 100

⇒ P = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

The total amount (A) is the sum of the Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Calculating Principal from Amount

If the total amount is given instead of interest, use: P = (A × 100) ÷ (100 + RT).

Effective Rate of Interest

For Simple Interest, the effective rate for the entire period is simply the product of the annual rate and the number of years (R × T).

questions.question:
What is the mode of the following data?

47, 43, 50, 46, 46, 40, 54, 54, 40, 54, 42, 48, 44, 55, 52, 45, 41, 41
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Mode** of a data set is the value that appears most frequently.

By scanning the given numbers, we find the following frequencies:

Numbers **40, 41, and 46** each appear **2 times**.

The number **54** appears **3 times**.

All other numbers appear only once.

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Data:** 47, 43, 50, 46, 46, 40, 54, 54, 40, 54, 42, 48, 44, 55, 52, 45, 41, 41

**Method:** Create a **Frequency Distribution** to identify the observation with the maximum count.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/860a5355e45a29772b7326b320ab85f0d4f03b45d3f41d21b59f5af5a3046e09.png] 

Calculations for frequency of each unique observation:

⇒ Number 40: **2 occurrences**

⇒ Number 41: **2 occurrences**

⇒ Number 46: **2 occurrences**

⇒ Number 54: **3 occurrences**

⇒ Others (47, 43, 50, 42, 48, 44, 55, 52, 45): **1 occurrence each**

⇒ Since 54 has the highest count (3), it is the mode of the data.

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Formula

In a moderately asymmetrical distribution, the relationship is given by: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Types of Mode

Data with one mode is **unimodal**, two modes is **bimodal**, and more than two modes is **multimodal**.

Median for Ungrouped Data

First, arrange data in **ascending order**. If n is odd, Median = ((n+1)/2)th term. If n is even, Median is the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

questions.question: A quantity is first decreased by 12% and then again decreased by 8%. What is the overall percentage decrease?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two **successive decreases** of a% and b%, the **overall percentage decrease** is calculated as:

**Net Decrease** = [a + b − (a × b)/100]%

Given a = 12 and b = 8:

**Net Decrease** = [12 + 8 − (12 × 8)/100]% = [20 − 0.96]% = 19.04%

**∴ The correct answer is 19.04%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First decrease = **12%**

Second decrease = **8%**

**Formula Used:**

Net Change = **Initial Value** × (1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a43c69e8460c696a665b2ec9d5b3b2a2fb3a40a5141c878fa4954b9582820843.png] 

⇒ Let the **initial quantity** be 100.

⇒ Value after **first decrease** = 100 − (12% of 100) = 88.

⇒ Value after **second decrease** = 88 − (8% of 88).

⇒ Calculation: 88 − (8 × 88)/100 = 88 − 7.04 = 80.96.

⇒ **Total percentage decrease** = 100 − 80.96 = 19.04%.

**∴ The correct answer is 19.04%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

If a value is changed by x% and then by y%, the net percentage change is (x + y + xy/100)%. Use positive for increase and negative for decrease.

Single Equivalent Discount

For two successive discounts of d₁% and d₂%, the single equivalent discount is (d₁ + d₂ − d₁d₂/100)%.

Base Change Rule

Percentage changes are always calculated on the **preceding value** in a successive series, not the original initial value.

questions.question: If the cost of 8 pens is ₹136, then find the cost of 12 such pens.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Quantity** = 8 : 12 ⇒ 2 : 3

Since cost is **directly proportional** to quantity:

2 units = ₹136

1 unit = 136 ÷ 2 = ₹68

3 units = 68 × 3 = ₹204

**∴ The correct answer is ₹204.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total cost of **8 pens** = ₹136

Required number of **pens** = 12

**Formula Used:**

This problem follows the **Unitary Method** where we first find the value of **one unit**.

Cost of N items = (Cost of 1 item) × N

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f547bfecc589f6d35b52483e9b2c8ac3386516f0f2aa2cddea754cebacdbbc3.png] 

⇒ Cost of 1 pen = Total Cost ÷ Total Pens

⇒ Cost of 1 pen = 136 ÷ 8

⇒ Cost of 1 pen = ₹17

⇒ Now, cost of 12 pens = (Cost of 1 pen) × 12

⇒ Cost of 12 pens = 17 × 12

⇒ Cost of 12 pens = ₹204

**∴ The correct answer is ₹204.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method

A technique where we find the value of a **single unit** first to calculate the value of any required number of units.

Direct Proportion

Two quantities are in **direct proportion** if an increase in one leads to a corresponding increase in the other. Formula: x₁/y₁ = x₂/y₂.

Inverse Proportion

When an increase in one quantity causes a decrease in the other (e.g., more men taking less time). Formula: x₁ × y₁ = x₂ × y₂.

questions.question: The difference between the present ages of Ayushi and Nidhi is 26 years. Five years ago from now, the sum of their ages was 30 years. If Ayushi is older than Nidhi, find Nidhi's present age (in years).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Present Sum** of ages = Sum 5 years ago + (2 × 5) = 30 + 10 = 40 years.

**Present Difference** of ages = 26 years (Given).

Nidhi's age (younger) = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2 = (40 − 26) ÷ 2 = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Difference (Ayushi − Nidhi) = 26 years. Sum (5 years ago) = 30 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d653c5e84a74de1a91fff7d4baf5b6718bd8f165f3733754383be3f563d7049.png] 

Let **Ayushi's** age be A and **Nidhi's** age be N.

⇒ A − N = 26 ----(Equation 1)

Five years ago, their ages were (A − 5) and (N − 5).

⇒ (A − 5) + (N − 5) = 30

⇒ A + N − 10 = 30

⇒ A + N = 40 ----(Equation 2)

Subtracting Equation 1 from Equation 2:

⇒ (A + N) − (A − N) = 40 − 26

⇒ 2N = 14

⇒ N = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Difference Rule

The **age difference** between two individuals always remains constant, whether calculated in the past, present, or future.

Age Sum Property

If there are 'n' persons, their **total sum of ages** increases or decreases by (n × t) years over a time period of 't' years.

Sum and Difference Formula

When the **Sum (S)** and **Difference (D)** of two numbers are known: Larger number = (S + D) ÷ 2 and Smaller number = (S − D) ÷ 2.

questions.question:
A hollow cylindrical pipe has an external radius of 7 cm, internal radius of 6 cm, and height of 20 cm. Find the total surface area of the pipe (both ends included).

 (Use pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct formula for **Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a hollow cylinder:

**TSA** = 2π(R + r)(h + R − r)

Given: **External radius (R)** = 7 cm, **Internal radius (r)** = 6 cm, **Height (h)** = 20 cm.

TSA = 2 × (22/7) × (7 + 6) × (20 + 7 − 6)

TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 13 × 21 = 44 × 13 × 3 = 1716 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 1716 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**External radius (R)** = 7 cm

**Internal radius (r)** = 6 cm

**Height (h)** = 20 cm

**π** = 22/7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0a0993ec1693433154282830ef2e59d08b04124722136ec9ab536e4395e854a.png] 

**Step-by-step Calculation:**

⇒ Outer Curved Surface Area = 2 × π × R × h = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 20 = 880 cm²

⇒ Inner Curved Surface Area = 2 × π × r × h = 2 × (22/7) × 6 × 20 = 5280/7 cm²

⇒ Area of two circular ends (rings) = 2 × π × (R² − r²) = 2 × (22/7) × (7² − 6²)

⇒ Area of ends = 2 × (22/7) × (49 − 36) = 2 × (22/7) × 13 = 572/7 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = Outer CSA + Inner CSA + Area of Ends

⇒ TSA = 880 + (5280/7) + (572/7) = 880 + (5852/7)

⇒ TSA = 880 + 836 = 1716 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1716 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Hollow Cylinder

The amount of material used to make the pipe is given by the volume formula: V = πh(R² − r²).

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

For a hollow cylinder, LSA is the sum of the outer and inner curved surfaces: LSA = 2πh(R + r).

Cross-sectional Area

The area of the ring formed at the base is A = π(R² − r²).

questions.question: If x = 5 + 2sqrt{6} , then find the value of (x - 1)/(sqrt{x)} .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify **factors of 6** whose sum is **5**: these are 3 and 2.

⇒ √x = √3 + √2

The expression (x − 1) / √x simplifies to **√x − 1/√x**.

Since (√3)² − (√2)² = 1, the **reciprocal** 1/√x is √3 − √2.

⇒ Result = (√3 + √2) − (√3 − √2) = 2√2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x = 5 + 2√6

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

⇒ x = 3 + 2 + 2√(3 × 2)

⇒ x = (√3)² + (√2)² + 2 × √3 × √2

⇒ x = (√3 + √2)²

⇒ √x = √3 + √2

⇒ (x − 1) / √x = (x / √x) − (1 / √x) = √x − (1 / √x)

⇒ 1 / √x = 1 / (√3 + √2)

⇒ **Rationalizing the denominator:** 1/(√3 + √2) × (√3 − √2)/(√3 − √2) = √3 − √2

⇒ (x − 1) / √x = (√3 + √2) − (√3 − √2) = 2√2

**∴ The correct answer is 2√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root of Surds

For a surd of the form a + 2√b, if we find two numbers p and q such that p + q = a and pq = b, then √(a + 2√b) = √p + √q.

Rationalization of Denominators

To rationalize 1/(√a + √b), multiply both numerator and denominator by its **conjugate** (√a − √b).

Conjugate Rule

If x = a + √b and a² − b = 1, then the reciprocal 1/x is simply a − √b.

questions.question: A Aarju starts a business with ₹55,000 and after 3 months, Bimla joins Aarju as her partner. After a year, the profit is divided in the ratio 8 : 9. What is Bimla's contribution in the capital?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **partnership**, **Profit Ratio** = **(Capital × Time) Ratio**.

Profit Ratio of **Aarju** and **Bimla** = (55000 × 12) : (CapitalB × 9) = 8 : 9.

Cancelling 9 on both sides: 55000 × 12 / CapitalB = 8.

CapitalB = (55000 × 12) ÷ 8 = 55000 × 1.5 = 82,500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹82,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Data:**

**Capital** of **Aarju** (CA) = ₹55,000

**Investment Period** of **Aarju** (TA) = 12 months

**Investment Period** of **Bimla** (TB) = 12 − 3 = 9 months

**Profit Ratio** (PA : PB) = 8 : 9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c7915f2a704afd74c830a0b1456ad513ebe9e96d6e2bc9e4bbd789fceb6ac1.png] 

**Formula Used:**

P₁ ÷ P₂ = (C₁ × T₁) ÷ (C₂ × T₂)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 8 ÷ 9 = (55000 × 12) ÷ (CB × 9)

⇒ 8 ÷ 9 = (55000 × 12) ÷ (9 × CB)

⇒ 8 × 9 × CB = 55000 × 12 × 9

⇒ 8 × CB = 55000 × 12

⇒ CB = (55000 × 12) ÷ 8

⇒ CB = 55000 × (3 ÷ 2)

⇒ CB = 55000 × 1.5

⇒ CB = 82500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹82,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Profit Sharing

In a simple partnership, profits are shared in the ratio of investments if the time period is the same. In a **compound partnership**, profits are shared in the ratio of the product of **capital** and **time**.

Working and Sleeping Partners

A **working partner** manages the business and may receive an additional share or salary from the profit, whereas a **sleeping partner** only invests money.

Capital-Time Inverse Relation

For a fixed amount of profit, the **capital** invested is inversely proportional to the **time**: C₁ × T₁ = C₂ × T₂.

questions.question: The simplified value of sqrt{225} + sqrt{0.04} - sqrt{4.84} is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Evaluate the **square roots** directly by recognizing perfect squares:

√225 = 15

√0.04 = 0.2 (since √4 = 2 and 2 decimal places become 1)

√4.84 = 2.2 (since √484 = 22 and 2 decimal places become 1)

Required value = 15 + 0.2 − 2.2 = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** √225 + √0.04 − √4.84

**Method:** Convert decimals to fractions to simplify finding the **square roots**.

⇒ √225 = 15

⇒ √0.04 = √(4 ÷ 100) = 2 ÷ 10 = 0.2

⇒ √4.84 = √(484 ÷ 100) = 22 ÷ 10 = 2.2

⇒ Now, substitute these values back into the expression:

⇒ 15 + 0.2 − 2.2

⇒ 15.2 − 2.2 = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Roots of Decimals

The number of **decimal places** in the square root is always half the number of decimal places in the original number (e.g., √0.0001 = 0.01).

Perfect Squares to Remember

Memorizing squares like 15² = 225, 22² = 484, and 25² = 625 is essential for **fast calculation** in competitive exams.

BODMAS Rule

Always follow the **BODMAS/VBODMAS** priority (Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction) for simplification problems.

questions.question: Which number, when added to each of the numbers 2, 3, 11 and 13, will make the resulting numbers in proportion?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the **constant number** to be added to **a, b, c, and d** to make them proportional, use the formula:

x = |(ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c))|

Here, a = 2, b = 3, c = 11, d = 13.

x = |(2 × 13 − 3 × 11) ÷ ((2 + 13) − (3 + 11))| = |(26 − 33) ÷ (15 − 14)| = |−7 ÷ 1| = 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/315a81e2f4f750dd19fa171e5a8139d02da9ba7fa5f65c5f2ca6aca2c370da6c.png] 

**Given:** Numbers are 2, 3, 11, and 13. Let the **number to be added** be x.

**Formula Used:** If a, b, c, d are in **proportion**, then (a + x) ÷ (b + x) = (c + x) ÷ (d + x).

⇒ (2 + x) ÷ (3 + x) = (11 + x) ÷ (13 + x)

⇒ (2 + x)(13 + x) = (11 + x)(3 + x)

⇒ 26 + 13x + 2x + x² = 33 + 3x + 11x + x²

⇒ 26 + 15x = 33 + 14x

⇒ 15x − 14x = 33 − 26

⇒ x = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fourth Proportional

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a:b = c:d), then d is called the **fourth proportional** and d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

The **mean proportional** between two numbers a and b is given by the formula √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in **continued proportion** (a:b = b:c), then c is the third proportional and c = b² ÷ a.

questions.question: The difference between the present ages of Juhi and Surbhi is 24 years. Five years ago from now, the sum of their ages was 66 years. If Juhi is older than Surbhi, find Surbhi's present age (in years).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age increase for **Juhi** and **Surbhi** in 5 years = 5 × 2 = 10 years.

**Present Sum** of their ages = 66 + 10 = 76 years.

Given **Difference** in ages = 24 years (Juhi is older).

**Surbhi's age** (Younger) = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2 = (76 − 24) ÷ 2 = 52 ÷ 2 = 26 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 26 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between **Juhi (J)** and **Surbhi (S)** = 24 years ⇒ J − S = 24

Sum of ages 5 years ago = 66 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e37f4c18aff6cf6863cdfdc4d2b9d724322b1864dbe884a2c2130b02a1ffc6c.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Sum of ages after **n** years = Past Sum + (Number of people × **n**)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (J − 5) + (S − 5) = 66

⇒ J + S − 10 = 66

⇒ J + S = 76 ----(Equation 1)

⇒ J − S = 24 ----(Equation 2)

Subtracting Equation 2 from Equation 1:

⇒ (J + S) − (J − S) = 76 − 24

⇒ 2S = 52

⇒ S = 52 ÷ 2 = 26

**∴ The correct answer is 26 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The numerical difference between the ages of two people always remains the same, regardless of how many years pass or how many years ago it was.

Sum of Ages Rule

If the sum of ages of 'n' persons is 'S' at present, then 'x' years ago, the sum was S − (n × x), and 'x' years hence, it will be S + (n × x).

Finding Individual Values

Given Sum (S) and Difference (D) of two values: Larger = (S + D) ÷ 2 and Smaller = (S − D) ÷ 2.

questions.question: A tap fills a tank in 11 hours. Another tap empties the full tank in 22 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill the tank completely, if the tank is empty and both the taps are open together?

Use the direct formula for one **filling tap** (x) and one **emptying tap** (y):

Net time taken = (x × y) ÷ (y − x)

Where x = 11 hr and y = 22 hr.

Time = (11 × 22) ÷ (22 − 11) = (11 × 22) ÷ 11 = 22 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 22 hr.**

questions.question: The mean of a data is 20 and its median is 30. The mode (using empirical relation) of the data is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **empirical relation** between measures of central tendency is **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Substitute the given values: **Mode** = 3(30) − 2(20).

**Mode** = 90 − 40 = 50.

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Mean** of the data = 20

**Median** of the data = 30

**Formula Used:**

For a **moderately skewed distribution**, the **empirical formula** is:

**Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aceb42151bbf2e8b64c45191b84d81b25507ceea0082df7d47407ee45855f46d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Mode** = 3 × 30 − 2 × 20

⇒ **Mode** = 90 − 40

⇒ **Mode** = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relation Applicability

The formula **Mode = 3Median − 2Mean** is an approximation used specifically for **moderately skewed** frequency distributions.

Symmetric Distribution

In a perfectly **symmetrical distribution** (like the Normal distribution), the **Mean**, **Median**, and **Mode** are all equal (**Mean = Median = Mode**).

Positively Skewed Distribution

For a **positively skewed** distribution (tail to the right), the relation is generally **Mean > Median > Mode**.

Negatively Skewed Distribution

For a **negatively skewed** distribution (tail to the left), the relation is generally **Mean < Median < Mode**.

questions.question:
Find the perimeter of the semi-circle of radius 21 cm

 (Take pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **semi-circle**, the relationship between **perimeter (P)** and **radius (r)** is simplified as:

P = r × (36/7)

Given **radius (r)** = 21 cm

P = 21 × (36/7) ⇒ 3 × 36 = 108 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 108 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius (r)** of the semi-circle = 21 cm

Value of **π** = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

**Perimeter of semi-circle** = **Length of Curved Arc** + **Diameter**

Perimeter = πr + 2r

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40764877467012cdc7610eb07568576fbfe852d38c50729aecabcf7f53f4e20b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Length of curved arc = π × r

⇒ Arc length = (22/7) × 21

⇒ Arc length = 22 × 3 = 66 cm

⇒ Diameter of semi-circle = 2 × r

⇒ Diameter = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

⇒ Total Perimeter = 66 + 42

⇒ Total Perimeter = 108 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 108 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Semi-circle

The space occupied by the semi-circle is half the area of a full circle: Area = (1/2) × π × r².

Perimeter of a Quadrant

For a quarter-circle (quadrant), the perimeter is calculated as (πr/2) + 2r, which simplifies to 25r/7 when π = 22/7.

Circumference vs Perimeter

Circumference usually refers to the distance around a full circle (2πr), while perimeter of a sector or semi-circle includes the straight boundaries (radii or diameter).

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours, pipe B in 15 hours, and an outlet C can empty it in 20 hours. A and B are opened together for 5 hours, and then C is also opened. Find the total time to fill the tank.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 12, 15, and 20 is **60 units** (Total Work).

Efficiencies: A = 5, B = 4, C = −3 (outlet).

Work done by A + B in 5 hr = (5 + 4) × 5 = **45 units**.

Remaining work = 60 − 45 = 15 units.

Combined efficiency (A + B + C) = 5 + 4 − 3 = 6 units/hr.

Total time = 5 + (15 ÷ 6) = 5 + 2.5 = 7.5 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: A traveller moves from City A to City B at 48 km/h and returns at 60 km/h. If the total time taken for the whole journey is 9 hours, find the distance between A and B.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

One-way Distance = [ (Product of Speeds) ÷ (Sum of Speeds) ] × Total Time

⇒ Distance = [ (48 × 60) ÷ (48 + 60) ] × 9

⇒ Distance = [ 2880 ÷ 108 ] × 9

⇒ Distance = 26.666... × 9 = 240 km

**∴ The correct answer is 240 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Speed **A → B** = 48 km/h, Speed **B → A** = 60 km/h, **Total Time** = 9 hr.

**Formula:** Speed is inversely proportional to Time when Distance is constant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac79de9c7424754aa9f81e40d8ce257c904581db911f119eed5fe253dc730313.png] 

⇒ Ratio of Speeds (A→B : B→A) = 48 : 60 = 4 : 5

⇒ Ratio of Time taken (A→B : B→A) = 5 : 4

⇒ Total time units = 5 + 4 = 9 units

⇒ 9 units = 9 hours ⇒ 1 unit = 1 hour

⇒ Time taken from **City A** to **City B** = 5 × 1 = 5 hours

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time = 48 km/h × 5 hr = 240 km

**∴ The correct answer is 240 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

When a person travels equal distances at speeds x and y, the **Average Speed** for the whole journey is (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Total Distance vs. Displacement

In this journey, the total distance covered is 2D (480 km), while the displacement is 0 as the traveller returns to the starting point.

Conversion Factor

To convert speed from **km/h** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s** to **km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

questions.question: If an exterior angle of a regular polygon is 40°, then find the number of diagonals of the polygon.

For a **regular polygon**, the number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ **exterior angle**.

questions.question: A man sells two articles for ₹42000 each. He gets a profit of 45% on one article and loses 45% on the other article. What is his overall profit or loss (to the nearest integer) in this transaction?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two articles are sold at the same **Selling Price (SP)** with equal **Profit%** and **Loss%** (x%), there is always a net loss of (x²/100)%.

Net Loss % = (45 × 45) ÷ 100 = 20.25%.

Total SP = ₹42,000 + ₹42,000 = ₹84,000.

Loss Amount = [Loss% ÷ (100 − Loss%)] × Total SP = [20.25 ÷ 79.75] × 84,000.

Loss Amount ≈ 0.2539 × 84,000 ≈ ₹21,329.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹21,329 loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Selling Price** of each article = ₹42,000, **Profit** on first = 45%, **Loss** on second = 45%.

**Formula Used:** **Cost Price (CP)** = [SP × 100] ÷ (100 ± P/L%)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a366a6ade34a6778935465a6bb1bac89ecc764b743a1b2a01727e1172a2f7d8.png] 

⇒ CP of first article = (42,000 × 100) ÷ 145 ≈ ₹28,965.52

⇒ CP of second article = (42,000 × 100) ÷ 55 ≈ ₹76,363.64

⇒ **Total CP** = 28,965.52 + 76,363.64 = ₹1,05,329.16

⇒ **Total SP** = 42,000 + 42,000 = ₹84,000

⇒ **Overall Loss** = 1,05,329.16 − 84,000 = ₹21,329.16

⇒ Nearest integer = ₹21,329 loss.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹21,329 loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Percentage Change

When a value is increased by x% and then decreased by x%, the net change is always a decrease of x²/100 %.

Same CP Case

If two articles are bought for the same **Cost Price** and sold at x% profit and x% loss respectively, there is **No Profit, No Loss** in the whole transaction.

Successive Profit/Loss

For successive changes of a% and b%, net change % = [a + b + (ab/100)]%, where positive values are for profit/increase and negative for loss/decrease.

questions.question: If 15 notebooks cost ₹240, then how many notebooks can be bought with ₹992?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the **Ratio Method**: 15 notebooks : ₹240 = x notebooks : ₹992

Reducing the first ratio: 1 : (240 ÷ 15) → 1 : 16

This means every 1 notebook costs **₹16**.

Number of notebooks (x) = 992 ÷ 16 = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62 notebooks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial quantity = **15 notebooks**

Initial cost = **₹240**

Available amount = **₹992**

**Formula Used:**

Cost of 1 unit = Total Cost ÷ Total Quantity

Required Quantity = Available Amount ÷ Cost of 1 unit

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e8207d5cf8e013ca067ced89f0f78b1e71adb09ee9f143feba42db990246fdb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Cost of 15 notebooks = ₹240

⇒ Cost of 1 notebook = 240 ÷ 15

⇒ Cost of 1 notebook = ₹16

⇒ Number of notebooks for ₹992 = 992 ÷ 16

⇒ Number of notebooks = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62 notebooks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method

A technique where we first find the value of a **single unit** and then multiply it by the required number of units to find the total value.

Direct Proportion

When two quantities increase or decrease at the **same rate**, they are in direct proportion. Formula: x₁/y₁ = x₂/y₂.

Cost Calculation

Total Cost = Unit Price × Quantity. Conversely, **Quantity = Total Cost ÷ Unit Price**.
